svg.aria-label: JSON bytes pass parse_bounded_json, which refuses documents over 16 MiB, nesting over 128 levels or arrays over 100,000 items, then validate_contract checks the schema and returns one of five typed contracts; any failure is a stable error code. Separately, jcs_canonicalize turns a value into RFC 8785 bytes and jcs_sha256 into a sha256-jcs digest.
